name: Đĩa mềm cam
description: Đĩa mềm 3,5 inch cam đỏ, chốt kim loại và nhãn trắng không chữ.

origin.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single reusable photographic Pop Collage cutout of a genuine-looking 3.5 inch floppy disk, nearly front-on, full intact square silhouette. Orange-red plastic shell, real silver metal shutter at TOP, plain cream paper label at bottom, no text or logos. Convincing photographic surface and printed grain, subtle halftone; saturated contemporary editorial collage, NOT a vector illustration or 3D clay render. Thin irregular white cut-paper contour follows entire object. No external cast shadow, no props, no background; real transparent alpha around isolated subject. Leave transparent margin on all edges. This is an illustrative video foreground piece.
